subject: Read-only compiler v2 contract review and verified real producer packet hashes
body:
Read-only new compiler review snapshot: mali_compute_compiler.c SHAde03eb77de17243805aa600d642b34687b6b54dd9b3edf002312f5fe11304a20, header218b62b311861ccb770954b7b365974209914ef7fe42939412bd2b3b791f8e75 against pipeline_format.h dfc0a410. Checked additive export, unaligned SPIR-V copy, specialization scalar declaration validation, live access reflection before pointer removal, direct set0 mapping, actual-shadow flags, combined pair provenance, internal dummy2[256], canonical storage-format map, exact serialized offsets/reservedzero and final parser validation. No new manifest-schema mismatch found in these paths. Legacy export stays TGP1; TGP2 image/buffer atomic metadata does not mean runtime atomic support (bridge refuses ATOMIC).

Independently read all seven existing real producer TGP2 packets: each hash matches result.json, code_offset+code_bytes equals exact file length. Four TestFastMath Threads package local headers are8x4,8x1,1x4,1x1, corroborating frontend original-local blocker. nearest/linear TestFastMath and accumulate manifest/access match the recorded actual producer plans; no GPU execution implied. Compiler report binary SHA cf888f92d4bd5577d6eebde1dd66824119787ddb4c06e5ce0287a71c9e028273; record source/build hash with final freeze rather than assuming current moving source produced it.

Requested lowerer boundary checks before freeze: float buffer/image atomic operations and64-bit atomic widths. Current reflection admits generic atomic operation; pinned bifrost_compile.c1189..1203 has integer-only opcode switch with unreachable default, and no float-atomic lowering was found. This is a source-derived test gap, NOT a reproduced crash. Lowerer owns tests and shared Mesa lease; reviewer did no build or production edit.
